newsitem.title: USA: TWA, Northwest matching UAL sale.
newsitem.headline: TWA, Northwest matching UAL sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc and Northwest Airlines Corp said Tuesday they will each match air fare discounts of up to 45 percent being offered by UAL Corp's United Airlines.
"We will be competitive with their offering," Northwest spokesman Jon Austin said.
"We are matching on every single route we compete with them on," TWA spokesman Donn Walker added.
Earlier, United said it is reducing summer/fall airfares up to 45 percent from 21-day advance purchase fares.
United said the sale begins immediately and is available through July 11. Domestic travel must be completed between July 14 and November 19. International travel must be completed by December 12.
